- Build a complete, playable open-world dark-fantasy game inspired by *The Witcher 3*, with quest monsters as bosses and abundant resources.

- Implement directly in the existing project; do not ask clarifying questions.

- Developed the existing “Ash & Oath” concept into an original fantasy setting, the Gloaming Vale, with four named boss contracts, gathering, crafting, and healing.
